vehicles are dropped off/picked up and parked/managed by a valet operator
under a permit issued by the City of West Palm Beach.
Use of a valet stand must comply with the standards and permit

Revocation or Suspension
A valet permit can be revoked or suspended anytime if the operator loses required permits or insurance, breaks
conditions, or causes safety problems. The City can also pause or end a permit for street work or emergencies
and isn’t responsible for any damage. If a suspension lasts more than 15 days, fees will be adjusted. If a permit is
revoked, no refunds are given.
